incident.title: The backup has a strict budget
incident.brief: The primary slows under a long generation burst. The alternate model is approved for voice and batch. At least 96% of voice turns and 70% of batch jobs must meet their deadlines. The alternate pool can serve at most 35% of completed requests. Avoid an unnecessary blanket reroute.

model.reason: The plan preserves batch where targets allow it, and does not violate any approval restrictions.

revision.reason: Alternate pool serves 35% of requests, prioritizing voice, and admits 50% of new batch requests during fault, with 50% of primary capacity reserved for voice.
